subject: Order form: split invoicing / evidence handoff for Clearline Therapeutics
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearline.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form: split invoicing / evidence handoff for Clearline Therapeutics

Hi Elena / procurement team,

Thanks for the conversation yesterday. We reviewed the commercial redlines offline and want to confirm the path forward so legal and finance can finalize. High level asks from your side:
- Invoice split: Clearline requests Q1 invoice to be billed to Clearline US (net 30) and subsequent tranches billed to Clearline UK (EU entity) for local VAT handling.
- Net terms waiver for initial activation / onboarding invoice (Clearline needs net 0 for the first payment only).
- VAT handling: Clearline will provide reverse-charge evidence for the UK entity, and needs that referenced on the invoice.

Attached: initial PO stub (Clearline_PO_0428.pdf).

Questions for us: can Redwood support a split invoicing flow (two recipients on the order form) and a one-time net terms waiver for onboarding? If yes, we need a clean Order Form redline to send to procurement that reflects: 1) invoice recipient table, 2) one-off net terms clause, 3) VAT evidence attachment reference.

Kimberly / Ben — can you confirm whether Finance + Legal accept the above routing and, if not, what alternate language we should propose? I can then circulate a final redline and route to DocuSign.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0173

[Attachment: Clearline_PO_0428.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearline.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearline.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form: split invoicing / evidence handoff for Clearline Therapeutics

Markus — thanks for the clear summary. Quick responses inline: 

1) Split invoicing: Finance can support dual invoice recipients but we need to see the entity legal names and tax IDs for both invoice recipients so accounting can map them. Please ask Clearline to provide: legal entity name, VAT/Tax ID, billing address, and the remit email or AP contact.

2) One-time net terms waiver: Legal is fine with a one-time "initial invoice due on receipt" clause if we add explicit language limiting it to the first invoice associated with this order form and if Clearline confirms PO acceptance. We'll add a short carve-out in the payment terms section; Ben, can you prepare suggested wording?

3) VAT reverse-charge: We need the actual evidence file (signed statement) and, as a standard, we reference the document name on the invoice. If Clearline will upload the evidence to the DocuSign envelope or share via secure link, that works.

Ben — please draft the redline language for the payment terms (net terms waiver) and the invoice recipient table. I will produce an Order Form redline doc (OrderForm_redline_v3.docx) and circulate to Clearline.

Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

[Attachment: none]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearline.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearline.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form: split invoicing / evidence handoff for Clearline Therapeutics

Thanks — drafted proposed language below (will drop into OrderForm_redline_v3.docx):

--- Proposed payment clause (to be inserted under Section 3: Payment) ---
"Notwithstanding the Payment Terms set forth in the Agreement, Customer agrees that the initial invoice associated with this Order Form (the \"Onboarding Invoice\") shall be due on receipt. All subsequent invoices will be subject to the Net 30 payment term stated in the Agreement, unless otherwise mutually agreed in writing. The Onboarding Invoice designation shall be limited to the first invoice issued under this Order Form and shall not apply to any future renewals or separate order forms unless explicitly stated."

--- Proposed invoice recipient table (new Annex A) ---
"Invoice Recipient 1: Clearline Therapeutics, Inc. (US) — remit to: accounts-payable@clearline.com; Tax ID: [TO BE PROVIDED]
Invoice Recipient 2: Clearline Therapeutics UK Ltd (UK) — remit to: ap-uk@clearline.com; VAT ID: [TO BE PROVIDED]; Include reference to 'VAT reverse-charge evidence: VAT_reverse_charge_evidence.zip' on invoice."

I also propose a short acceptance checkbox in DocuSign where customer confirms that they uploaded VAT evidence and PO. If Clearline won't upload, we can accept a secure link to the evidence.

Markus — once you get the entity names + tax IDs from Clearline, I'll finalize the docx and run a light legal check (no heavy MSA redline needed for this language).

Ben Carter
Senior Commercial Counsel, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
